question: What results when the surge of the innate form becomes great in intuitive insight?
premises: The innate form can surge to a great degree.
Some become established in the nature of flash insight.
Such establishment leads to excellence in poetry and eloquence.
inference: When the surge of the innate form is great, those established in intuitive insight certainly attain complete poetic and eloquent excellence.
plain_english: But when that surge becomes great, those established in the nature of intuitive insight certainly attain, in every way, excellence in poetry and eloquence.
